sync.title: Sync and cutover
sync.description: Until cutover Torqvoice follows Shopmonkey: changes made there come over, and an edit made here to an imported record is overwritten by the next change there.
sync.cutOver: Cut over {time}. Nothing more comes from Shopmonkey.
sync.webhookHelp: Add a webhook in Shopmonkey under Settings, Integration, Webhooks with this address, and enter the signing secret it shows in the connection above. Without it, changes come over within ten minutes.
sync.noSync: Nothing synced yet. The sync starts after the first load.
sync.kept: {count, plural, one {# record Shopmonkey deleted was kept} other {# records Shopmonkey deleted were kept}}
sync.keptHelp: They were changed here since they were last synced, are locked invoices, or are records the sync never deletes. Decide on each.
sync.dryCompleted: Dry run {time}: every step would go ahead.
sync.stoppedAt: Stopped at step {step}. Nothing after it was done.
sync.failed: The cutover did not finish. The connection's activity log says why.
sync.interrupted: The cutover stopped before it finished: its job is no longer queued. Run it again.

step.stopped: The shop has stopped editing Shopmonkey
